description: Use after the person confirms the job description and asks to get quotes from local contractors. Saves a draft and returns a private link. The person opens the link and gives an email for receiving bids. BidCraft emails them an invite to track the bids; once they click it, BidCraft contacts local contractors on their behalf. Nothing is sent to any contractor by this tool. Leave out street addresses, names, emails, phone numbers and budgets.
